items.title: SpaceX stock falls as Starship's test flight slips to Sept. 28, retail investors sell shares
items.summary: SpaceX fell nearly 2% on Friday, paring its gain for the week to around 1%, as investors weighed a delay to the company's first orbital Starship flight against a fresh round of bullish commentary from one of its largest backers.

items.title: Waymo Is Doing So Much More Than Most Understand, Keeping Me Buying Alphabet Hand Over Fist
items.summary: Most investors still see Alphabet as a search-and-ads company with a cloud kicker, but there is a commercial-scale robotaxi network buried inside the valuation that changes the entire risk-reward calculation.

items.title: Eisman: Tesla’s Multiple Is Crazy Unless You “Believe that Tesla’s Robotaxi Business will Conquer the World.” “Count Me As a Skeptic”
items.summary: Steve Eisman, the investor who called the 2008 housing collapse, says Tesla's valuation only makes sense if you accept one enormous assumption about robotaxis, and he wants no part of it.

items.title: Betting On A Tesla Roadster By 2027: A No-Brainer or Brainless?
items.summary: Tesla just ripped 8% in a month on Roadster hype, but prediction markets give that car only a one-in-three shot at arriving by 2027. Before you buy the excitement, understand what the income statement is quietly signaling.

items.title: SpaceX Stock Is on a Good Run While Retail Investors Are Selling. What Gives?
items.summary: Elon Musk’s army of small, retail shareholders has helped prop up  Tesla  stock in the past.  Many of those same retail shareholders now hold  SpaceX.  Retail investors, however, have started selling SpaceX stock.

items.title: Coinbase Files to List U.S. Single-Stock Perpetual Futures
items.summary: Coinbase Global said Friday that it has sought regulatory approval to list perpetual futures tied to individual large-cap U.S. stocks.  Perpetual futures, known as “perps,” are speculative derivative contracts that never expire, allowing traders to pile on leverage that amplifies their potential gains and losses.  Coinbase plans to list perps tied to roughly 50 to 60 popular stocks such as Apple, Microsoft, Tesla and Nvidia.
